title: Potted Plant with Ladybugs
description: A close-up view of a lush potted plant with rounded green leaves covered in water droplets. Several bright red ladybugs with black spots are visible on the leaves and stems, with small yellow flower buds emerging.
prompt: Close-up of a vibrant potted plant with rounded, textured green leaves glistening with realistic water droplets. Bright red ladybugs with black spots crawl on the foliage and stems. Small yellow flower buds are visible. The plant sits in a weathered brown pot. Soft natural lighting, highly detailed botanical painting style with rich textures and natural colors.
